## Selection rule (registered before any re-scoring)

Ranked by download count across all 3,996 `open-llm-leaderboard/*-details` datasets — a proxy
for the models the community actually consults — then **capped at 4 per organisation** so no
single lab dominates. Every entry below was verified on 2026-08-08 to exist and to contain
per-sample generations for generative leaderboard tasks (MATH, GPQA, MMLU-Pro, BBH, MuSR,
IFEval). The cap is what makes this a sample of the leaderboard rather than a sample of Meta.

Do not substitute models ad hoc once results are visible — that turns a fixed sample into a
chosen one. If the rule needs changing, change it and re-run the whole selection.
